leo: quick thought 1: what if profiles had a "fidelity dimmer" (0..1) to smoothly interpolate between FP8 and lower-bit kernels?
anya: explain runtime semantics?
leo: runtime treats dimmer as interpolation weight between two kernels; adjust at token boundaries with hysteresis.
rachel: liking smoother transitions. need a simple contract and safety floor.
matt: prototype caveat: interpolation adds a bit of compute during transitions, will bench.
anya: ops: require min_quality, hysteresis_s, per-endpoint budget cap, and opt-out flag.
rachel: telemetry: run synthetic prompts every 10m, emit "dimmer_regression" if deg_score shifts.
leo: rollout plan: staging canary -> 5% prod -> monitor deg_score, latency, cost -> auto-rollback on regression.
matt: I'll push kernel prototype + perf numbers.
anya: I'll write short RFC follow-up with contract fields and checklist.
sre-bot: noted: will propose alert thresholds and oncall runbook.
